There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

title: Solution Architect & TechLead (w/m/d) - 3D-SaaS und AWS
description:
Wir suchen Dich!

Als Solution Architect & Tech Lead (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die Architektur unserer 3D-SaaS-Plattform InfraCloud und entwickelst Lösungen für die digitale Inspektion und das Asset-Management von Bauwerken. Du übersetzt Produktanforderungen in technische Konzepte, leitest das Entwicklungsteam fachlich und bringst Dich auch selbst in die Softwareentwicklung ein.

Verstärke unser Team in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in Hamburg oder arbeite remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Die Position ist unbefristet; Deine Arbeitszeit gestaltest Du flexibel innerhalb eines Kollaborationsfensters von 8:00 bis 19:00 Uhr deutscher Zeit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Solution-Architektur von InfraCloud und übersetzt Produktanforderungen in technische Designs, Datenmodelle, API-Verträge und Integrationskonzepte.

  • Du entwickelst die Architektur der 3D-Pipeline und der mobilen Field-App weiter – einschließlich Performance, Skalierbarkeit, Offline-Synchronisation und Konfliktbehandlung.

  • Du konzipierst Integrationen mit Kunden- und Partnersystemen, etwa GIS-Plattformen und Sensordiensten, und gestaltest die sichere Einbindung von KI- und LLM-Funktionen.

  • Du führst das Entwicklungsteam fachlich, begleitest Design- und Code-Reviews, unterstützt Releases und arbeitest bei Sicherheitsfragen und Infrastrukturbedarfen mit dem Security-Team und dem AWS Managed Service Provider zusammen.

  • Du entwickelst rund 30–40 % Deiner Arbeitszeit selbst Prototypen und kritische Komponenten, behebst bei Bedarf Produktionsprobleme und treibst Testautomatisierung sowie technische Qualität voran.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens acht Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon mindestens drei Jahre in einer Architektur- oder Tech-Lead-Rolle für ein B2B-SaaS-Produkt; Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ohne disziplinarische Verantwortung und sicherer Umgang mit Scrum.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Application Security, Secure Coding sowie Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, etwa OWASP Top 10, OIDC, RBAC und MFA; Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling und der Behebung von Schwachstellen.

  • AWS-Kenntnisse auf Anwendungsebene, insbesondere EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, S3 und RDS; Kenntnisse in Terraform und GitLab CI/CD sowie Praxis im Lesen, Reviewen und Schreiben von JavaScript und TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit 3D- und Geodaten, etwa 3D Tiles, Meshes, Punktwolken, Photogrammetrie oder GIS-Integration; sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit Offline-first-Architekturen, KI- und LLM-Integration, Testautomatisierung oder Observability; Deutschkenntnisse und Berührungspunkte mit Bauwerksprüfung, Vermessung, Bauingenieurwesen oder Hydrographie.Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwarearchitektur und der Leitung von Entwicklungsteams mit.

description:
Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien.

Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front.

Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur.

Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe.

Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre.

Ce que tu vas faire chez nous

  • Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production.

  • Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler.

  • PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité.

  • Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes.

  • Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs.

  • Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi.

Ce qui t'attend techniquement

  • Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo

title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)

description:
About finmid

At finmid, we’re building infrastructure that integrates access to capital for SMEs directly into the platforms they use daily. We leverage technology, data, and strategic partnerships to deliver financing solutions that significantly outperform traditional financial services - offering SMEs faster, simpler, and more transparent access to funding.

Wir wachsen weiter und suchen Verstärkung für unser Entwicklungsteam. Du entwickelst bei uns nicht im luftleeren Raum, sondern direkt an dem, was Praxen und unser Customer-Success-Team zurückmelden. Dein Schwerpunkt: Produktfunktionen und Schnittstellen-Integrationen, die im Praxisalltag einen echten Unterschied machen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und erweiterst Produktfunktionen auf Basis von Kundenfeedback und Rückmeldungen aus dem Customer Success.

  • Du baust und pflegst Schnittstellen-Integrationen zu PVS- und Drittsystemen (REST-APIs, Webhooks, Datenabgleich) und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag zuverlässig laufen.

  • Du analysierst Fehler und Integrationsprobleme gemeinsam mit Customer Success, findest die Ursache und behebst sie dauerhaft statt nur symptomatisch.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success, Support und Produkt zusammen und bringst Dein technisches Urteil in die Priorisierung ein.

  • Du schreibst sauberen, getesteten und gut dokumentierten Code und gestaltest unsere Architektur und Entwicklungsprozesse aktiv mit.

  • Du achtest bei allem, was Du baust, auf Datenschutz und Sicherheit (DSGVO, BSI C5).

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise mit PHP (Laravel), Python und/oder Go. Du musst nicht alles mitbringen, aber Lust haben, Dich in mehrere Sprachen einzuarbeiten.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit der Anbindung externer Systeme: REST-APIs, Authentifizierung, Fehlerbehandlung, Debugging über Systemgrenzen hinweg.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git, Linux und relationalen Datenbanken.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an Ursachenforschung.

  • Klare Kommunikation im Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Support und Customer Success, auch wenn diese keine Entwickler sind.

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

At Zattoo, we bring linear TV to the internet and make it personal for millions of viewers across Europe. Many TV platforms, our own and those of our B2B partners, run on the same backend. The backend team builds and runs the services behind all of them.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll design and run the Python services and APIs that keep this experience fast and reliable, including at peak times like live sports finals. title: Backend Engineer, AI Systems
description:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

  • Develop inference orchestration systems that connect LLMs, application services and external tools

  • Design APIs for streaming responses, asynchronous processing and real-time interactions

  • Improve system performance through caching, batching, concurrency and database optimisation

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and error handling for production services

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues involving latency, service failures and high traffic

  • Work with ML, frontend and mobile engineers on API design, system integration and deployment

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years of backend software engineering experience building production systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python, Node.js or similar backend technologies

  • Experience designing and maintaining REST or gRPC APIs, databases and distributed services

  • Understanding of asynchronous processing, concurrency, caching and message queues

  • Experience building scalable services and optimising latency, throughput and resource usage

  • Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Docker and cloud infrastructure

  • Ability to debug production issues using logs, metrics and distributed tracing

 

Nice to Have

title: Member of Technical Staff — Platform Engineering
description:
Member of Technical Staff — Platform Engineering

Remanence is pioneering the next era of enterprise AI by building intelligent systems that learn continuously from real-world execution. We transform complex enterprise workflows and business context into dynamic, interactive environments where AI agents can safely learn, adapt, and improve. By combining high-fidelity simulation environments with state-of-the-art training loops, we build specialized models that solve long-horizon, complex tasks with unmatched reliability. We're building the most talent-dense AI team in Europe to make this happen.

You’ll build the platform that brings our research into production, making Remanence easy to deploy and operate in customer clouds and on-premises.

What you'll work on

  • Build deployment tooling for our training, evaluation and inference systems.

  • Automate installations, upgrades and rollbacks.

  • Make deployments work within customers’ security and access requirements.

  • Build monitoring and diagnostics for systems we cannot access directly.

  • Work with researchers on sandboxing and distributed workload orchestration.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
description:
About the team:

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

 

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.

  • Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.
  • Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.
  • Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting.   • 3+ years of software engineering or machine learning engineering experience, including building AI applications

  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompting, tool calling and agent workflows

  • Understanding of LLM capabilities, limitations, inference and context management

  • Experience evaluating AI outputs, debugging failures and improving model-driven workflows

Bei riok entwickeln wir individuelle Software, von der Datenbank über die API bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Wir suchen eine engagierte Person, die mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Software bauen möchte, die technisch überzeugt und sich gut bedienen lässt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Anwendungen im Frontend und Backend mit Technologien wie .NET, Angular, oder React.

  • Du setzt Anforderungen in durchdachte, intuitive Benutzeroberflächen um.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Team und unseren Kunden zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

  • Du gestaltest technische Entscheidungen mit, reviewst Code und hilfst uns, unsere Arbeitsweise weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Neben Kundenprojekten hast du die Möglichkeit, an unseren Open-Source-Projekten und eigenen Produkten wie Mapperly und Kreya mitzuarbeiten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Anwendungen im Frontend und Backend.

  • Ein Gespür für Design, Layout und Interaktion, du erkennst, wenn etwas noch nicht stimmig ist, und möchtest es verbessern.

  • Freude daran, selbstständig zu lernen, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu finden.

  • Eigeninitiative und Verlässlichkeit: Du bleibst dran, fragst nach und kommunizierst offen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, mit denen du dich im Team und mit unseren Kunden austauschen kannst.

Du musst nicht alle unsere Technologien bereits kennen. Wir schätzen solide Grundlagen, sorgfältige Arbeit und die Bereitschaft dazuzulernen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Überwiegend remote arbeiten: Ein bis zwei Tage pro Woche verbringen wir gemeinsam im Team oder bei einem Kunden.

  • Gute Ausstattung: Ein grosszügiges Gerätebudget, damit du mit einer Ausstattung arbeiten kannst, die zu dir passt.

  • Geförderter öV: Ein Halbtax-Abonnement für den öffentlichen Verkehr in der Schweiz.

  • Erholung: 25 Ferientage pro Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen zu kaufen.

  • Raum zum Mitgestalten: Du bringst dich sowohl technisch als auch bei der Benutzererfahrung ein.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Worte darüber, warum du bei riok arbeiten möchtest. Zeig uns gerne auch etwas, das du entwickelt hast, ein berufliches Projekt, ein privates Projekt oder einen Open-Source-Beitrag.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. APIs, health monitoring and machine configuration management

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting.   • Work with engineering and product teams to develop, test and release AI features

  • Strong Python programming skills and experience developing production backend systems

  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompting, tool calling and agent workflows

  • Understanding of LLM capabilities, limitations, inference and context management

  • Experience evaluating AI outputs, debugging failures and improving model-driven workflows

  • Knowledge of APIs, databases, asynchronous processing and distributed systems

  • Experience deploying, monitoring and maintaining production applications

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Ledger Platform team.

You'll design and build iwoca's new ledger platform – the distributed system that records every movement of money, starting with the business credit card and moving on to loans.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

The team

The Ledger Platform team is rebuilding all of iwoca’s ledgers as one platform, starting with the ledger for the business credit card. Every card payment, loan repayment, and payout will end up there. Finance, Accounting, and Capital Markets rely on that record, so it has to be right every time.

title: Software Engineering Intern
Chief Information Security Officer
description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and lead

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and lead

We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services.

We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result.

  • Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards.

  • Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field.

  • Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team.

  • A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

  • The ability to understand a complex system and its domain quickly, and to translate that understanding into clear architecture and well-scoped tasks.

  • Hands-on experience working with AI coding agents, or the curiosity and drive to build that skill fast, including the judgment to verify and correct what they produce.

  • Day-to-day experience with Linux as a development and target

title: Research and Development Engineer in Formal Methods - 12 months contract
description:
Who we are ?

Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.

The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders.

The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios.

A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines.

Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. title: Co-Founder & COO (m/w/d) gesucht für Corporate Philanthropy Plattform | Düsseldorf/Remote
description:
Über Bonoboo


Bei Bonoboo bauen wir die Plattform für Corporate Philanthropy. Mit KI-gestütztem Matchmaking verbinden wir Unternehmen gezielt mit passenden gemeinnützigen Organisationen. Das Ziel: messbare Wirkung, effizientere Spendenprozesse und datenbasiertes gesellschaftliches Engagement. Wir sind ein wachsendes, internationales Team mit Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf und wollen die Spendenbranche nachhaltig verändern.

Wo wir stehen
Unser Produkt ist validiert, und erste Unternehmen setzen Bonoboo bereits zahlend ein. Wir sind mitten in der Pre-Seed-Phase, mehrere Business Angels sind an Bord, und das Kapital für die nächsten Schritte ist gesichert. Jetzt geht es darum, aus einem funktionierenden Produkt ein skalierendes Unternehmen zu machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Wer wir sind

  • Julia, CEO & Founder: bringt Expertise in Sales und Finance mit und verantwortet Vertrieb, Finanzen und Fundraising.

  • Max, CTO & Co-Founder: hat Erfahrung als KI-Entwickler und verantwortet Produkt und Tech.

Was uns noch fehlt, ist die Person, die den Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo nicht nur mitdenkt, sondern operativ führt und nach außen trägt.

Deine Aufgaben als Co-Founder & COO

Du verantwortest den gesamten Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres Start-ups maßgeblich mit.

Strategie & Impact
Du denkst mit uns die großen Fragen: Wie skaliert Corporate Philanthropy? Wo hebeln wir Wirkung am stärksten? Du bringst strategische Klarheit in ein Feld, das oft unscharf bleibt.

Operative Leitung Impact
Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für alles, was mit Impact zu tun hat, von Prozessen bis zur Reporting-Logik. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Vision gelebte Praxis wird.

NGO-Partnernetzwerk & Success Management
Du baust unser Netzwerk an NGO-Partner:innen auf und pflegst es. Du verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften auf der Plattform für beide Seiten wirklich funktionieren.

Bühne & Pitches
Du bist eines der Gesichter von Bonoboo: auf Startup-Bühnen, bei Pitches und im Gespräch mit Kund:innen, Partner:innen und Investor:innen. Du erzählst unsere Story mit Substanz, Überzeugung und Begeisterung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in Strategy, Business Development oder Operations, idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu CSR, HR oder dem NGO-Sektor

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du treibst Dinge eigenständig voran und baust Prozesse und Strukturen auf, statt nur darüber zu reden.

  • Kommunikationstalent: Du begeisterst andere für Impact-Themen, auf der Bühne genauso überzeugend wie im 1:1 mit unseren NGO-Partner:innen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung für das Ganze übernehmen und Bonoboo gemei

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenAPI
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: Eleve

Mission Freelance – Expert DevOps Cloudflare One

Zero Trust | Security Engineering | Terraform | GitOps

Contexte

Pour le compte d'un grand groupe français du secteur de l'énergie, nous recherchons un Expert DevOps Cloudflare pour accompagner le déploiement et l'industrialisation d'une plateforme de sécurité Cloudflare à l'échelle de son système d'information.

L'objectif est de concevoir, configurer et automatiser les solutions Cloudflare, d'accompagner leur mise en production et d'assurer leur transfert aux équipes internes.

Principales responsabilités

  • Zero Trust & ZTNA : déploiement de Cloudflare Access et WARP, migration progressive depuis un VPN Fortinet, sécurisation des accès Citrix, des accès privilégiés et des partenaires externes.
  • Secure Web Gateway : migration depuis Zscaler vers Cloudflare Gateway, filtrage Web contextuel et protection des utilisateurs nomades.
  • Data Security & AI Governance : mise en œuvre de DLP, CASB, Browser Isolation et contrôles Shadow IT / Shadow AI.
  • Application & API Security : configuration WAF, protection anti-DDoS, sécurisation des API et mécanismes mTLS.
  • Email Security : déploiement de Cloudflare Email Security et intégration avec Google Workspace.
  • DevOps & Automation : automatisation des configurations Cloudflare via Terraform, API et GitOps, avec gestion du code sous Git/Bitbucket.
  • Observabilité & transfert : intégration des événements au SIEM, documentation technique, procédures d'exploitation et transfert de compétences aux équipes SecOps.

Requirements

Compétences indispensables

  • Expertise confirmée sur Cloudflare One : Zero Trust, Access, Gateway, WAF, Email Security, Browser Isolation et API Cloudflare.
  • Maîtrise avancée de Terraform, notamment du provider Cloudflare.
  • Expérience GitOps avec Git/Bitbucket.
  • Solides compétences cloud AWS et GCP.

title: DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System (m/f/d)
description:
DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System

Our AI analyses real production lines through cameras and edge devices in customer factories. We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer who understands how systems work underneath, from the OS and network up to the cloud, and who will own the software on our growing device fleet and the infrastructure that runs it.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the software on our edge fleet once a device is online: components, configuration, and OS, kernel and GPU driver updates.

  • Build the release path to devices: CI/CD, canary, staged rollouts and rollback over unreliable factory networks.

  • Run fleet monitoring and alerting that catches failing devices and cameras before customers notice; decide whether a fault is software or hardware.

  • Debug hard problems across the stack (processes, memory, disk, network, GPU) and fix root causes, not symptoms.

  • Own our cloud infrastructure in Terraform, including the central systems we use to manage the edge fleet (AWS).

  • Work closely with our Installations team, who set up devices and networks on site.

     

You are

  • 8-10 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE or systems roles.

  • Strong OS fundamentals: processes, memory, file systems, boot, services. You can debug a Linux machine from the shell.

  • Solid networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls.

  • Experienced with automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform a must, Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Comfortable with containers and AWS.

  • Methodical and curious: you want to know why something broke, not just make it work again.

 

Nice to have

  • Have run a fleet of remote, on-prem or edge machines (IoT, retail, telecom).

  • AWS IoT Greengrass or similar device management.

  • NVIDIA GPUs or Jetson: drivers, CUDA.

  • Unattended installs or OS images (PXE, cloud-init, ...).

  • Kubernetes in production.

description:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with.

About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary.

What you’ll do

  • Security features for customers. Build things like end-to-end encrypted secrets, log redaction, private networking, and runtime hardening.

  • Automated offensive testing. Use AI tools to attack our own systems on a schedule, find weak spots, and fix them. Bring in outside pen testers when it’s worth it.

  • Detection and response. Build monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, improve our security observability, and lead the response when something needs a look.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO (Tech & Strategic Projects)
description:
At Vicoland, we give the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies, in short: “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). Enabled through our unique AI-driven SaaS platform, Vicos allow freelance experts to team up and act like a real company, competing successfully for large enterprise projects.

Our Vicos are already transforming how professional services projects are done. Since our launch 1.5 years ago, Vicos won projects from large corporate clients such as Mercedes-Benz, Netflix, or the German Federal Government, as well as from many mid-sized businesses. Vicoland was mentioned by Forbes and Forrester as a leading force in the market.

Our SaaS platform is an integrated solution of marketing, organizational, legal and financial tech. It includes a marketplace that matches clients and Vicos. It is integrated into the world’s leading procurement software provided by one of our partners, SAP.

There are already 100+ Vicos on our platform, uniting thousands of freelancers. Our central team has 40 members and is located across Europe, expanding to the US. Our headquarters are in Frankfurt/Main.

Our offer to you

You’ll be the CEO’s tech-savvy right hand for AI-centric strategic projects with measurable business impact. From day one, you’ll scope, launch, and deliver cross-functional initiatives aimed at shaping strategy, building operating muscle, and turning ideas into shipped outcomes. You’ll work directly with the CEO and collaborate closely with Product, Software Development, and Partnerships team members. We operate hybrid: regular on-site collaboration in Frankfurt am Main with the CEO (e.g., on key project days) while retaining flexibility to work remotely or from one of our offices (Frankfurt, Walldorf, Barcelona, Seville). Clear career perspectives into Strategy & Partnerships, Product, or Operations leadership as you prove impact.

Tasks

  • Drive CEO special projects end-to-end: define problem statements, scope work, set milestones, coordinate stakeholders & team members, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Establish AI-first workflows (e.g., agentic automations, data pipelines) together with Product/Software Development to improve Vico operations and our platform.
  • Pilot and operationalize the “AI agent” role inside Vicos; document learnings and scale playbooks.
  • Support partnerships exploration: research targets, prepare outreach materials, analyze strategic fit, and help bootstrap pilot collaborations.
  • Prepare crisp analyses and decision memos for the CEO (market scans, business cases, OKRs) and track execution against company priorities.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional sprints that translate strategy into product/operations changes; ensure risks, dependencies, and comms are managed

title: Senior Software Engineer, Visual Optimization (Backend focused)
description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Every great trip starts with a photo that makes someone say, “I need to be there.” As part of our Visual Optimization team, you’ll build the platform behind that moment, owning how millions of images and videos travel from upload to a traveler’s screen. That spans scalable storage on S3, fast transformation and delivery via Cloudflare, foundations for video at scale, ranking and recommendation systems that learn from image performance, moderation and quality models that keep our inventory clean and compliant, and the self-serve APIs, events and tools that make it easy for teams across GetYourGuide to use our services.   • 6+ years of software development experience working with distributed systems or search engines.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

title: Senior Talent Partner (12 month FTC)
description:
Senior Talent Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000

Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire.

We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with.

Why this role exists now

Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace.

We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position.

The role

You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls.

Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer.

  • Partnering with hiring managers in every team: shaping briefs, setting expectations and balancing competing priorities.

  • Running structured interviews to a high bar, making confident calls on borderline cand

Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The core of our system is the computer vision algorithms that allow drones to understand the world around them. title: Business Development Representative - Cybersecurity
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect talented professionals with exciting career opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our client network includes growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS businesses, and technology-driven companies across sectors such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Rather than following the traditional outsourcing model, we place you directly within innovative companies, where you become a valued member of their team.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) with a proven background in the cybersecurity industry to join a growing international technology company.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, engaging key decision-makers, and generating qualified sales meetings through strategic outbound prospecting.

The ideal candidate understands the cybersecurity landscape, can confidently communicate technical value propositions, and has experience selling cybersecurity solutions to B2B customers.

Previous experience working in cybersecurity sales is a strict requirement for this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect potential B2B customers through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and other outbound sales channels.
  • Generate and qualify leads, building a consistent pipeline of sales opportunities.
  • Engage IT Directors, CISOs, CTOs, Security Managers, and other relevant decision-makers.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospects' cybersecurity challenges, business needs, and purchasing priorities.
  • Communicate the value of cybersecurity products and services to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Schedule qualified meetings and product demonstrations for Account Executives and senior sales teams.
  • Maintain accurate prospect records, sales activities, and pipeline updates in CRM platforms.
  • Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to improve outreach strategies, messaging, and conversion rates.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed KPIs related to outreach activity, qualified meetings, and pipeline generation.

Requirements

  • Mandatory: Previous professional experience in the cybersecurity industry, preferably in a BDR, SDR, or outbound sales role.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity solutions, industry terminology, and common security challenges faced by businesses.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer Angular / Kotlin – Spring Boot, AWS (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest im Projektteam eines großen Mobilitätsunternehmens an einer Webanwendung für die Fahrplanplanung. Das Team umfasst rund zehn Leute und arbeitet nach Scrum in Zwei-Wochen-Sprints. Projektsprache und Dokumentation sind Deutsch.

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Webanwendungen mit Angular und TypeScript
  • Backend-Entwicklung mit Kotlin und Spring Boot, Betrieb auf AWS
  • Lieferpakete bauen über CI/CD mit Gradle, Git, GitLab und Artifactory
  • Unit- und End-to-End-Tests schreiben, Fehler beheben, auch in fremdem Code
  • Aufwandsschätzungen, Code Reviews und Systemdokumentation
  • Abstimmung mit Projektleitung, Design und den anderen Entwicklern

Die Arbeit läuft remote. Vor Ort bist du nur bei einzelnen Terminen.

Wo du landest

  • Großkonzerne aus Mobilität und Logistik
  • Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei)
  • Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen

Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Das erwarten wir:

  • Angular und TypeScript, mehr als fünf Jahre
  • Kotlin und Spring Boot, mehr als fünf Jahre
  • Amazon Web Services, mehr als drei Jahre
  • Deutsch mindestens auf Niveau C1

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • CSS 3 und REST-Schnittstellen
  • Softwaretests, End-to-End-Tests mit Playwright
  • GitLab CI/CD
  • Erfahrung mit KI-Werkzeugen in der Entwicklung

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

  • Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest
  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner
  • Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Data die het verschil maakt

Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap?

Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Je draagt bij aan platformen die er echt toe doen: data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen bij NS, moderne beleggingsplatformen bij Robeco en schaalbare data ecosystemen bij EDSN en Stedin. Je ontwerpt en bouwt schaalbare data pipelines in Cloud omgevingen, ontwikkelt betrouwbare datamodellen die organisatiebreed worden gebruikt en denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance en onderhoudbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je plek binnen LINKIT

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in leren, verbinden en vooruitkijken.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.

  • 5+ jaar ervaring in data engineering binnen complexe omgevingen.

  • Ervaring met CI/CD op cloudplatformen.

  • Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

  • Je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en spreekt vloeiend Engels.

  • Pré: ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric of BigQuery.

Wat je krijgt

title: Data Engineer
description:
Bouwen is pas de helft van het werk

Data draait nooit om de tool, maar om de vraag erachter. Als Data Engineer bij LINKIT ga je die vraag niet uit de weg, je zoekt hem juist op.

De uitdaging

Als Data Engineer werk je aan dataplatformen die er in de praktijk toe doen: bij NS aan data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen, bij Robeco aan moderne beleggingsplatformen, en bij EDSN en Stedin aan schaalbare data-ecosystemen in de energiesector. Je bouwt en onderhoudt data pipelines in de Cloud, ontwikkelt datatransformaties en datamodellen met SQL en Python, en werkt met tools als Snowflake, Databricks of Fabric en orchestration tools zoals Airflow, dbt of ADF. Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening.

Je hebt een goede basis als Data Engineer en bent klaar voor de volgende stap: niet alleen bouwen, maar ook doorgronden waarom een platform zo is ingericht als het is. Je denkt mee met analytics-, BI- en data-science teams, en ziet feedback als brandstof voor groei.

Je plek: de Data Engineering squad

Je maakt onderdeel uit van de Data Engineering squad: vakinhoudelijke collega's die net als jij nieuwsgierig zijn naar het waarom achter elke oplossing. Kennis delen zit in het DNA van de squad, niet alleen tijdens projecten, maar ook op de clubdag, de tweewekelijkse vrijdag op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern waarop we tijd vrijmaken voor leren en verbinden. Benieuwd wie je toekomstige collega's zijn?

Lees hier meer over de Data squad.


Wat we vragen

  • 3+ jaar ervaring in een Data Engineer rol of vergelijkbare functie.

  • Een stevige basiskennis van SQL.

  • Ervaring met Python, Java of Scala als programmeertaal.

  • Kennis van of ervaring met distributed dataprocessing frameworks/datalakes zoals Spark, Flink, Delta Lake, Iceberg, etc.

  • Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

  • Leergierig, open voor feedback en gericht op inhoudelijke/technische groei.

  • Je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en spreekt vloeiend Engels.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €4.300-€5.700 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenreg

title: Business Analyst/ Product Owner Meldeverfahren (m/w/d) | Full Remote
description:
Die Gesellschaft für innovative Personalwirtschaftssysteme mbH ist ein führender Softwarehersteller von integrierten HR Management-Anwendungen für staatliche, öffentliche und soziale Arbeitgeber in Deutschland. Unser Produkt KIDICAP® ist seit 40 Jahren auf dem Markt und wird heute von rund 25.000 Organisationen als Cloud Service genutzt. KIDICAP® bildet eine moderne Web-APP-Plattform für alle Bereiche des Human Capital Managements und alle Unternehmensgrößen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt rund 200 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit wachsender Tendenz.

Zur Verstärkung des Entwicklungs-Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen:

Business Analyst/ Product Owner Meldeverfahren (m/w/d)

Arbeitsorte: Remote (Deutschland) oder Offenbach am Main oder Leipzig | Zeitmodell: Vollzeit

Die Tech & Produkt-Organisation

Aufbau: Die Tech & Produkt Organisation besteht aus knapp 160 Mitarbeiter:innen und ist verteilt auf 2 Bereiche (Core & Fachapplikationen) und insgesamt ca. 15 crossfunktionale Teams. Die Produkt-Teams sind nach Produktnutzergruppen ausgerichtet wie bspw. Lohnabrechnung, Mitarbeiter-Self-Service oder Personaladministration.

Kultur: Leitmotive sind „You build it, you run it“, “Common Ownership” und Clean Code. Die Arbeitsweise ist pragmatisch und agil. Agile Coaches stehen on Demand zur Verfügung.

Tools

  • Ticket-System: Jira
  • Dokumentation: Confluence
  • Office Suite: Microsoft 365
  • Kommunikation: MS-Teams

Deine Aufgaben

Du bist die fachliche Instanz für dein Meldeverfahren, von der gesetzlichen Änderung über die Berechnungslogik bis zur Auslieferung.

  • Analyse von Änderungen im Sozialversicherungsrecht und in den Meldeverfahren sowie deren Umsetzung in Anforderungen, Jira und unseren internen Systemen
  • Erstellung präziser Anforderungsspezifikationen und User Stories, Priorisierung gemeinsam mit dem Scrum-Team und (Mit-)Verantwortung für das Product Backlog
  • Weiterentwicklung des Produkts mit eigenen Ideen, inklusive Neukonzeption gewachsener Komponenten, wo der bestehende Ansatz nicht mehr trägt
  • Sicherstellung von Konformität und Wartung als verlässliche Basis für unsere Kunden
  • Enge Abstimmung mit Kunden als fachliche Ansprechperson
  • Unterstützung der fachlichen Qualitätssicherung sowie Verantwortung für Kommunikation und Dokumentation in deinem Bereich

title: Staff Software Engineer - Payment Processing
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

As a Staff Engineer (Payment Processing) at Checkout.com, you will set the technical direction for our Gateway, Routing and Payout platforms. Every payment and payout we process passes through these systems, from the merchant's API request to the routing decision that sends it to the right acquirer, payment method or payout rail. Correctness matters on every transaction, and small changes in availability, latency or routing quality show up directly in our merchants' approval rates and revenue.

This is a role for engineers who are energised by scale and by the hard trade-offs that come with it: latency budgets on the authorisation path, failure domains and blast radius, consistency and idempotency across regions, and the operational reality of running critical infrastructure around the clock.

You will operate as a force multiplier across multiple teams - shaping architecture, raising the engineering bar, and turning ambiguous, business-critical problems into designs that can be delivered incrementally. We're looking for individuals with deep technical judgement, strong ownership, and a pragmatic approach to breaking big problems into smaller iterations that deliver value continuously.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems, defining the service boundaries, data models and integration patterns that let t

title: Applied AI Software Engineer - Defense
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the role

Join Mistral AI’s Defense team to build software for defense institutions and industry.

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with strong engineering fundamentals and a background in data engineering or transactional, analytical or distributed systems. You will help shape the architecture, write production code and own substantial software components, from design through deployment and operation.

This role offers the scope and autonomy of a senior technical individual contributor in a small team. It is particularly suited to engineers operating at Senior or Staff level in demanding product engineering environments who want broad ownership and to stay deeply involved in implementation.

What you will do

  • Design and build services for data ingestion, transformation, storage, querying and operational workflows.

  • Develop shared data models, APIs and SDKs that help engineers build applications on a consistent foundation.

  • Make authorization a core part of the architecture: define and enforce which users, applications and agents can access data or perform actions, with clear audit trails.

  • Solve problems involving data consistency, schema evolution, concurrency, performance and failure recovery across services and data systems.

  • Turn needs from our applied engineers and defense users into reusable software capabilities, making pragmatic choices about what to build and how to evolve them.

  • Own delivery end to end, including implementation, testing, observability, debugging and maintainability in demanding deployment environments.

  • Use AI coding tools and coding agents extensively to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring and debugging. Help the team improve these workflows while maintaining a high engineering st

title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.

 

What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

  • Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

  • Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

  • ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

About Antithesis

We take cutting edge software-testing technologies and make them useful for finding real bugs in our customer’s software, allowing them to make more reliable software and ship with confidence.

Historically we’ve focused on the hardest testing problems, providing deterministic simulation testing of whole distributed systems, finding and helping people to understand bugs that would have been a nightmare to find in production.

As more and more code is written by agents, everyone is starting to realise just how important software verification is, and we’re in the process of expanding the problems and companies we target, and are providing an increasingly broad suite of open source and commercial testing tools for a much wider variety of problems and audiences.

We’re well funded, deeply technical, and committed to improving the quality of software across the board. If you’d like to help us do that, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

You'd be joining a small London-based team building out a new Antithesis product, focusing on a more downmarket and diverse set of customers than our main product. We’re rapidly iterating and expect to be shipping some time early in the new year.

We're looking for an engineer at the Senior to Staff level to help us make that system dependable. This will be “devops” in the traditional sense, though more dev than ops: You'll be a member of the engineering team, not a separate operations function, working in the same repository as everyone else, but your primary area of responsibility will be how the system runs in production. That means AWS, deployment, observability, alerting, and the on-call that comes with them.

There will be some on-call, shared with the rest of the team, and part of the job will be helping us define how that works. This is the first product Antithesis is shipping primarily out of the UK, and we want to get things right from the start to make it sustainable and quiet. We’re thinking of this role as less about being the person that gets paged, and more being the person who tries to make sure that nobody does.

Likely much of this will have already been prototyped by the time you join, but there will be a lot of latitude to make big changes to how that works.

What You'll Do

  • Own our AWS environment.

  • Define and build out our observability and alerting
