We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams.

The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. title: Head of Infrastructure
description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.

description:
Who we are ?

Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.

The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.

The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.

A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verif

Pensum: 40-100%

Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelin

title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
description:
Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security.

The role

Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina

You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them.

The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?).

This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right.

Working with design delivered as code

At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review.

This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening.

Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools

title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
description:
About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:

Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

We are seeking a strategic, people-focused Team Lead Functional Analyst to head our Functional Analysis & Process Design chapter within the Enterprise Applications & Integrations department. As tonies undergoes a company-wide transformation from a distributed landscape to a harmonized, global operating model powered by SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, our IT and business functions are moving toward a product-oriented organization.

In this pivotal role, you will provide horizontal leadership to our team of Functional Analysts -the vital translation bridge between our business value streams (Operations, Finance, Sales) and our technical delivery teams. The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of end-to-end business processes with a strong mentoring mindset, setting methodology standards and empowering the team to translate operational needs into scalable, standard-first enterprise solutions.

What you'll do

As Team Lead Functional Analyst, you will act as the Chapter Lead for Functional Analysis, providing both disciplinary leadership and methodological governance for your team.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Team Leadership & Development: Providing horizontal leadership to the Functional Analyst team, overseeing personal skill development, coaching, and managing capacity allocation across various value streams.

  • Methodology & Standards: Setting and enforcing best-practice methodology standards for the chapter, including process modeling (BPMN 2.0), agile requirements engineering, user story writing (Jira/Confluence), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) protocols.

  • Strategic Governance: Empowering your team

title: Senior Manager, Product Design (f/m/d)
Site Reliability Engineer (Remote)(Located in the United Kingdom)
Anaesthetic (Pain) Consultant
description:
At Montu UK, we are passionate about improving the lives of patients who have often exhausted conventional treatment options. Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

We are looking for Consultant Anaesthetists who are interested in exploring the growing field of medical cannabis and developing their expertise in chronic pain management.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes.

With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine.

Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care.

What is the job?

As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options.

Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine.

Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care.

Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management

As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales, delivered fully online in partnership with Learna.

The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

Agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

  • Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.

  • Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

title: Developer Community Lead
description:
About RhymeQ

RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming.

Your role

As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development.

You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size.

What you will do

  • Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME.
  • Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program.
  • Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation.
  • Create useful technical content: Develop tutorials, sample projects, livestreams, posts, and talks that make quantum programming approachable.
  • Support community contributions: Encourage developers to share their work, answer questions, and help others. Identify and support potential community ambassadors.
  • Connect developers with the product team: Turn questions, feedback, and recurring problems into clear recommendations for the compiler, tooling, and documentation.
  • Measure what works: Track acquisition, activation, retention, and contributions, and use the results to improve community programs.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s in computer science, PhD is preferred.
  • Over 2 years of experience growing a developer community for a technical product, with results you can demonstrate through active users, downloads, contributors, event participation, or other relevant measures.
  • Practical Python skills. You can run code examples, lead a live tutorial, and help a newcomer troubleshoot their setup.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and make learning engaging, whether in writing, on camera, or on stage.
  • Strong written and spoken English and confidence working with an internation

title: Enterprise Account Executive - English

description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely.

The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists.

Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios.

  • Build the pipelines and infrastructure that generate synthetic cybersecurity training instances at scale — thousands of scenarios, not one hand-crafted exercise.

  • Conduct experiments and evaluations of model capabilities on these environments, from quick prototypes to controlled benchmark runs.

  • Own the infrastructure behind the environments: containers, sandboxes, VMs, cloud deployments, and orchestration (Kubernetes), all managed as code.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
description:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

title: Research Engineer, Foundation Model (Multimodal Fusion & Distillation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.

This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.

What You'll Work On

  • Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.

  • Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.

  • Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.

  • Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.

  • Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.

  • Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.

A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know

title: Fullstack Software Engineer
iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

title: Commercial Account Executive, Growth | Remote | Germany
Senior Product Manager
Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner wo

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Our client is an established, family-owned industrial technology company headquartered near Zurich. Its systems run at customer sites in more than 60 countries. To keep them reachable and secure, it needs someone who can build and run the networks behind them, and who is comfortable intervening and troubleshooting when a customer's connection goes down.

What you'll do

  • Set up, run and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote-access VPNs to customer sites (IPsec, OpenVPN)

  • Configure and maintain firewalls (Fortinet, OPNsense and others)

  • Design and implement networks at customer sites: switching, routing, VLANs, WLAN

  • Find and fix network problems together with customers and colleagues around the world, remotely or on site

  • Install and roll out software on Windows and Linux systems

  • Build and maintain the internal test and lab networks

  • Keep network documentation clear and up to date, and help improve how the team works


What you bring

  • A completed IT or electrical engineering education (EFZ with further training, HF, FH or equivalent)

  • At least three years of hands-on experience in network or system engineering

  • Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching and firewalls

  • Real experience with VPNs, ideally IPsec and OpenVPN

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server

  • A calm, customer-focused way of solving problems, including under pressure

  • Fluent German and English

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site work

Nice to have

  • Linux administration

  • Scripting or automation (Python, Bash)

  • Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP or Fortinet NSE

  • A background in network or cyber security

What's on offer

  • Room to shape the role and how things are done

  • Flexible working model with home office (up to 60%)

  • Individual training and certification budget

  • Comprehensive social benefits

  • A long-term position in a stable, family-owned company

title: Robot Operator
description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role

You will be the key connector between the digital and physical world. You will physically guide and remotely operate (teleoperate) state-of-the-art robots using motion-capture systems. Your physical demonstrations will directly form the training data our neural networks use to learn complex, real-world tasks. You will teach the AI what good looks like.

  • Data Capture & Teleoperation: Perform high-volume task demonstrations (e.g., sorting objects, operating tools, door opening, manual assembly, cable manipulation) via motion tracking equipment.

  • Quality Assurance: Monitor data stream quality, tag trajectory metadata, and flag anomalies or edge-case physical behaviors to the AI engineering team.

  • Hardware & Setup Maintenance: Assist with staging environments, changing end-effectors, suggest hardware/software improvements and basic routine maintenance on the robot fleet.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Work directly with AI researchers and robotics engineers to iterate on teleoperation controls and data acquisition pipelines.

What We're Looking For

  • Comfortable piloting various robots for extended duration.

  • Strong hand-eye coordination, spatial awareness, and fine motor control.

  • Attention to Detail: A preference for an organized, functional workspace and a systematic app

title: Security Engineer, Incident Response
Mid-Market Account Executive - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

description:
About us

Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can’t get anywhere else. We’re a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

The Role

You’ll write the software that puts our OCS technology to work for AI. You’ll develop and benchmark custom kernel code on modern AI accelerator hardware, and help define how AI workloads are deployed across training, inference, and agentic use cases. You’ll follow the latest techniques in distributed AI systems and help shape the networks and network devices that come next.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and document custom kernel code for contemporary AI accelerator hardware

  • Develop and run benchmark tests for kernel code, document the results, and derive optimization strategies

  • Contribute to the definition and implementation of our AI workload deployment ecosystem

  • Track the latest techniques for writing and deploying communication kernels in distributed AI accelerator systems

  • Contribute to designing deployment strategies for our OCS technology, tailored to each AI/ML workload type (training, inference, agentic)

  • Play a vital role in the definition and design space exploration of novel networks and network devices

What We’re Looking For

  • Very good programming skills in one or more higher-level languages, with strong experience in C++ and Python

  • A deep understanding of AI accelerator hardware programming models

  • Good knowledge of distributed shared memory architecture concepts

  • You like being part of a team and being helpful to others

  • Curiosity, innovative thinking, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of technology

  • Good written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to broad audiences

Desirable

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
Forward Deployed Engineer
Lead Product Manager, Inference
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud. Our inference platform already serves production traffic at scale. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own the inference portfolio within our Cloud & Inference organization.

You'll set strategy, write specs, sit with customers running production traffic, and work across our inference, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams to deliver real customer impact. Example problems you may work on include figuring out the next inference product we should launch to help our customers scale their AI workloads or how we cut fraudulent free-tier usage without adding friction for legitimate users.

You will work on state of the art infrastructure, in close collaboration with our science and research engineering teams. Your job is to turn that infrastructure into products that AI-native startups and enterprises pay for, integrated with our developer platform Studio.

You will operate as an individual contributor first — taking end-to-end ownership of complex and significant product lines — while building the foundation for the inference PM team as the portfolio grows. The size and shape of the team reporting into the role will be defined together with the VP Product once you're in place; from day one the expectation is hands-on product leadership, not people management.

You will be the first PM fully dedicated to inference and the most senior product hire in the space. You will report to the VP Product - Cloud & Inference, and work day-to-day with our inference engineering teams in the US and Europe.

What you'll do

  • Strategy and vision: define the vision, strategy, and annual goals for the inference portfolio, aligned with customer needs and company objectives. Benchmark the managed-inference field and pick where we win.

  • Roadmap and execution: own

The Role

Mistral AI provides full-stack AI solutions, from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute, used by developers, enterprises, and public institutions worldwide. title: SaaS Engineer
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking a talented SaaS Engineer to take ownership of the full lifecycle of our SaaS and Software portfolio, from spend and license management to day-to-day governance and tooling policies. This will cover both Internal IT and Engineering SaaS and Software used across Mistral.

You will be the go-to person for everything SaaS: how much we spend, who has access, whether our tools are secure and compliant, and how new tools are evaluated and approved. You will map our AI connectors, integrations, MCPs and other tooling, define the associated policies, and report on costs and usage. Working closely with Security, Compliance, Finance, IAM and Procurement, you will help define and enforce how software is adopted across the company.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise, financial ownership and operational governance, this role offers the opportunity to shape how a fast-growing global organization manages and scales its software ecosystem.

What You Will Do

SaaS Cost and Billing Management

  • Own the SaaS budget: track spend, forecast costs, and report on SaaS expenditure to Finance and IT leadership.

  • Manage vendor contracts, renewals, and license tiers, working closely with our Procurement Manager and negotiating pricing at renewal where relevant.

  • Regularly audit licenses and seats, reclaim unused seats, and eliminate redundant or overlapping tools.

  • Work with IT leadership to define policies and budgets related to AI usage across Mistral.

  • Detect and reduce shadow IT spend and consolidate vendors wherever possible.

  • Build and maintain a complete and accurate SaaS inventory, including costs, owners, contracts, and renewal dates.

SaaS Governance and Operations

title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Quelques chiffres

  • 230 collaborateurs, dont 50 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the

title: Langfuse - DevRel Engineer, Events & Community (EMEA)
description:
Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; we're mainly remote and invite you to the Berlin office 3-5 days every two months.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

  • Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe

  • Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows.

  • Build and maintain field-ready material: demo flows, workshop runbooks, talk abstracts, event landing pages, follow-up emails, signup flows, and conference-in-a-box assets.

  • Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences.

  • Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well.

  • Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback.

 

What we're looking for

  • You have worked in DevRel, product marketing engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, developer advocacy, or technical community roles.

title: Principal Database Performance Engineer - Core Engineering (C++)
description:
NOTE: this role can be located anywhere ClickHouse has a hiring presence.

ClickHouse — Core Analytics Database

About the Role:
ClickHouse is looking for a Principal Database Performance Engineer to join the team behind our high-performance analytics database service.
In this role, you will drive performance and scalability improvements across the stack, taking on ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges most engineers never get to touch.
Our performance team owns the core of query execution - filters, aggregation, joins, and the index structures that make them fast.
We're looking for a sharp, passionate engineer who wants to own database performance end-to-end on a petabyte-scale cloud database, from initial analysis and implementation, through production rollout.

What you will do:
- Identify impactful performance and scalability opportunities in customer or benchmark workloads
- Architect and implement optimized database algorithms and data structures across core relational operators, indexes, query processing, memory management and scheduling
- Drive the performance roadmap for latency, throughput, memory efficiency and hardware utilization improvements
- Participate in the development of a complex, high-performance database system, including meticulous testing and safe production rollout
- Represent the company externally through presentations, blog posts, and community contributions
- Mentor and support junior engineers on the team

What You'll Bring
- 5+ years of experience in database performance engineering, distributed systems
- Master or PhD in databases or a related field
- Strong fluency in C++ and a background in performance-critical software or systems programming
- A track record of driving complex performance improvements end-to-end
- Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms
- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a proactive, goal-driven mindset

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

title: AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

title: Chief of Staff Intern
description:
What is Finary?

Money is broken. Most people's wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see, and a private banker costs more than they will ever pay. We are putting one in everyone's pocket: the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us, for free. Finary AI turns that financial context into a plan, and our own investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real: clarity on what you have, guidance on where you are going, action to get there.

Why now?

AI makes this vision possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy:

  • Data: years of per-user financial history, goals and risk profiles that no public dataset holds.

  • Brand: half of our new users come from our own channels, and 1 signup in 5 names our YouTube channel.

  • Licences: stocks, ETFs and crypto on one regulated platform, passportable across Europe. We started early, when a simple registration was enough: PSAN in 2022, Investment Firm licence in March 2026, MiCA in July 2026. Since July, every crypto platform in Europe must be licensed or stop.

Many fintechs will have the AI, and a few will have the licences. We have all 3. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman) and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.

description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst who can translate financial data into meaningful insights that support business decisions. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key financial processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis, helping us better understand business performance and plan for continued growth. You’ll collaborate with teams across the organization to identify trends, improve financial visibility, and support our evolving business needs. As part of a small, growing company, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening our financial operations and helping shape how we plan for the future.

This fully remote role reports to our Chief of Staff, and candidates are required to reside in the United States. This role requires legal authorization to work in the United States. EngagedMD is unable to sponsor current H1B visa holders for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Own the annual budgeting process, including budget development and planning.

  • Manage quarterly financial forecasts, incorporating business performance and updated financial projections.

  • Conduct monthly and quarterly budget-to-actual variance analysis, identifying key trends, discrepancies, and drivers of financial performance.

  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis to provide insights and support strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Assist with month-end accounting activities, including reviewing financial results and supporting accurate financial reporting, including limited journal entry posting.

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting efficiency, and the overall quality of financial insights provided to the business.

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in corporate finance, banking, Big Four accounting, or a related financial analysis or accounting role with a desire to transition to a finance oriented role.

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to query and analyze financial data.

Über uns

Wir bauen gerade eine zweite Business Unit auf: GEO-SEO für ausgewählte Nischen, die die großen Agenturen nicht beachten. Gemeint ist Sichtbarkeit dort, wo Menschen heute fragen, also bei Google und in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini. Die Nachfrage haben wir in den ersten Verkaufsgesprächen bereits bestätigt.

Dahinter steht Joberg, eine „kleine“, aber feine Marketing-Agentur. Unser erstes Standbein sind Paket-Mailings, mit denen unsere Kund:innen auf dem Schreibtisch von Entscheider:innen landen. Mit der neuen Unit expandieren wir in den SEO/GEO- und vielleicht in Zukunft in den SEA/GEA-Markt. Was dafür noch fehlt, bist du.

Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen.

Deine Perspektive

Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam.
