title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
London or Sheffield - 2 days per week in office, 3 days working remotely

ABOUT THE ROLE

Goodlord’s mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re on the hunt for a Business Systems Analyst to help us achieve this.

The Business Systems team plays a crucial role in driving efficiency across multiple departments including Sales, Customer Support, Marketing and Finance by optimising our internal processes and connected ecosystem. As a hands-on analyst, you will work throughout the full SDLC: partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their challenges, scoping scalable solutions, and implementing them directly in Salesforce.

Your work will be critical to driving business growth and achieving our strategic goals. To accomplish this, you will employ advanced automation and Salesforce’s latest AI capabilities to solve real business problems rather than just completing tasks. You will ensure robust data governance, seamless integrations with platforms like HubSpot, and disciplined process execution.

No two days are ever the same at Goodlord so what you’ll be up to will vary. The pace we move at also means priorities will change and you’ll need to be comfortable with this (we’ll support you!). But these are the things that will be core to your role and will keep you busy.

The day-to-day stuff:

  • Flexibly balance a mix of business as usual system admin tasks alongside the execution of long-term, strategic projects.

  • Partner directly with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their operational challenges, gather requirements, and translate them into clear, documented technical specifications.

  • Own the administration, configuration, and day-to-day support of core enablement tools and integrations, including GetAccept, Vonage, and HubSpot.

  • Map, manage and continuously improve the operational processes underlying our sales cycles.

  • Utilise Salesforce reporting, Data Loader, Import Wizard, etc to maintain an accurate database, while building visibility (dashboards/reports) for everyone from end-users to the executive team.

  • Proactively spot, triage, and systematically debug new system, AI, or process issues as they arise, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

ABOUT YOU

title: Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

This role is based in our San Francisco office and is also open to remote candidates in the US.

We're hiring an Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager to build and run the programs that fill our pipeline. You'll own campaigns across paid media, webinars, account-based marketing, and social, from strategy through launch and optimization.

This is a builder role. You'll stand up programs that don't exist yet, ship them quickly, and scale what works. You'll partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps to turn target accounts into qualified pipeline.

What you'll do

  • Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and content syndication channels, owning budget pacing, testing and reporting on CAC, pipeline and ROI

  • Run the webinar program end to end: pick topics and speakers, drive promotion and production, and manage follow-up through to pipeline conversion

  • Partner with Sales to define target account lists and build tiered account-based marketing plays (1:1, 1:few, 1:many), orchestrating multi-channel touches that drive engagement and meetings

  • Use paid and organic social to reach buyers, amplify campaigns and generate demand, working closely with Content

title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in France.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

  • Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

  • Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

  • Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

  • Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achiev

title: (Senior) FP&A Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a (Senior) FP&A Manager based in France.

We are looking for an experienced (Senior) FP&A Manager to act as a strategic finance business partner and drive financial performance across an international organization. In this role, you will lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning while transforming complex financial data into actionable business insights. You will work closely with senior leadership, commercial teams, operational stakeholders, and finance professionals to influence strategic decisions and improve business performance. Your expertise will help strengthen financial reporting, enhance planning processes, and ensure alignment between local and group-level objectives. This is an opportunity to take ownership of impactful financial initiatives in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment where analytical excellence and commercial thinking are highly valued.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will take ownership of financial planning and performance management, providing strategic insights and supporting business-wide decision-making. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business.

  • Translate financial and operational performance into actionable insights through variance analysis, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Partner with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance.

  • Develop and maintain robust financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to support decision-making and investment cases.

  • Ensure alignment between local German reporting requirements and group-level expectations within a U.S. publicly listed company environment.

  • Drive continuous improvements across FP&A processes, planning tools, data quality, reporting automation, and performance management routines.

  • Collaborate with external auditors, system implementation partners, and corporate reporting teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across financial processes.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders in an international business environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Approximately 7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, controlling, corporate finance, or a related finance function, prefer

Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

description:
Bist du bereit, dich mit uns auf eine spannende Reise zu begeben? Wir leben own (y)our growth und fördern ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung Hand in Hand gehen.

Stell dir vor, du betreust Kunden, die ein Produkt nutzen, das die Art und Weise, wie Parkplätze verwaltet werden, revolutioniert. Damit hast du einen bedeutsamen Einfluss auf die Zukunft der urbanen Mobilität.

Mit deiner Expertise in der professionellen B2C-Kundenbetreuung stärkst du unsere Position als Marktführer, während du als Customer Care Agent (all genders) gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Erfolge erzielst.

What to expect

  • Customer Care: Du hast engen Kontakt zu unseren Kund:innen und bist ihr erster Ansprechpartner

  • Complaint Management: Eigenständige Bearbeitung komplexer Beschwerden rund um Kennzeichenerfassung, Vertragsstrafen und Sonderfällen

  • Service Excellence: Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen und löst Probleme am Telefon sowie per Mail, um unseren Service auf höchstem Niveau zu halten

  • Team: Du reportest an den Customer Care Team Lead und arbeitest eng mit den Kollegen aus den Bereichen Customer Success, Project Management, Business Development, Engineering und Product zusammen

  • Optimierung: Du arbeitest aktiv an der Optimierung unseres Kundenservices und leitest Feedback an die jeweilige Abteilung weiter

Inspire us by

  • Dein Background: Du hast zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Kundensupport, Call Center oder Kundenbetreuung und dies mit dem Fokus auf (eskalierendem) Beschwerdemanagement

  • Deine Mentalität: Du verfügst über ein dickes Fell und ausgeprägte Standfestigkeit: Du kannst Kunden auf Augenhöhe klare Grenzen aufzeigen und unpopuläre Entscheidungen verbindlich vertreten, ohne dich provozieren zu lassen

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest gerne analytisch und suchst nach kreativen Lösungen für die Probleme deiner Kunden

  • Work Ethic: Du möchtest in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung arbeiten, Eigeninitiative zeigen und bist hoch motiviert neue Fähigkeiten zu erlernen

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast Deutschkenntnisse auf C2 Niveau und verfügst über grundlegende Englischkenntnis

About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

leakshield ist ein junges Legal-Tech-Start-up. title: Product Manager - Preclinical Device
description:
Location: London, with occasional travel.

 

About Netholabs

Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

 

The Role

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.

You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

 

What you'll do

  • Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

  • Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

  • Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

  • Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

  • Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

  • Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

  • Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirement

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

  • Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

  • Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

  • Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt.

Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Keine Agentur, kein Team unter dir, keine fertigen Prozesse. Du baust Marke, Community und Funnel von null auf – erst mit den eigenen Händen, dann mit einem Team.

Was dich erwartet: ein Hardware-Produkt plus Abo, Direktvertrieb in DACH und Eltern als Zielgruppe, die das Beste für ihre Kinder wollen und Datenschutz ernst nehmen. Und ein Thema, bei dem KI und Kinder in einem Satz stehen. Da gewinnt, wer Vertrauen aufbauen kann.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton.

  • Du baust unsere UGC-Maschine: Creator finden, briefen, Hooks schreiben, jede Woche 10–20 Ad-Varianten testen, lernen, wiederholen.

  • Du bringst 5.000 Familien auf die Warteliste, bevor es Onoo zu kaufen gibt – und hältst sie bei Laune (Newsletter, Social, „Kinderfrage des Tages“).

  • Du machst aus unseren Beta-Familien Fans: Reviews, Videos, Testimonial

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

description:

Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Wir sind eine globale Gemeinschaft, die auf starken Beziehungen und der Überzeugung basiert, dass sinnvolle Arbeit Leben verändert. Unser Leitprinzip „Earning, Learning, and Serving“ (Verdienen, Lernen und Dienen) prägt unser tägliches Handeln. Außerdem verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine Million Menschen mit zukunftsfähiger Arbeit zu verbinden und Führungspersönlichkeiten zu entwickeln, die andere inspirieren.

Unsere Kultur

Bei CloudFactory glauben wir daran, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle bestärkt, wertgeschätzt und inspiriert fühlen. Jeder soll seine eigene Persönlichkeit und individuellen Stärken bei der Arbeit voll entfalten können.

  • Menschenzentriert: Die persönliche Weiterentwicklung, das Wohlbefinden und das Zugehörigkeitsgefühl unseres Teams liegen uns sehr am Herzen.
  • Innovativ: Wir begrüßen Veränderungen und finden gemeinsam bessere Wege, Dinge anzugehen.
  • Global vernetzt: Wir fördern die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Kulturen und Perspektiven.

Wenn Sie sich für Innovation und Zusammenarbeit begeistern und in einem internationalen Umfeld wirklich etwas bewegen möchten, dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie in unserem Team willkommen zu heißen!

Ihre Position im Team
Als unser Senior Accountant - Finance & Payroll (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Finanzbuchhaltung, die Lohnabrechnung sowie die Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen Vorgaben für die deutsche Tochtergesellschaft von CloudFactory, die Hasty GmbH mit Sitz in Berlin. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem globalen Group Finance Team sowie den lokalen Fachabteilungen zusammen. Die Rolle bietet Ihnen ideale Voraussetzungen, sich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und gleichzeitig Teil eines sinnstiftenden Unternehmens zu sein.

Hybrid / Remote-first - weitgehend mobiles Arbeiten, kombiniert mit regelmäßiger Präsenz in unserem Büro in Berlin (mindestens ein Tag alle zwei Wochen) für den persönlichen Austausch und lokale Aufgaben.

description:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Services and join CSS, our support organisation.

You'll lead a small team of Zendesk and AI specialists and work day to day with the engineers who build our support tools.

You'll work closely with our knowledge and readiness team, support agents and team leads, product teams, our Company AI team, Data & Analytics, and our support and AI vendors.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Founding Legal Counsel to help us build Vio's legal function from the ground up – owning our commercial contracts, managing legal risk across the business and getting us ready for our next stage of growth.

This is Vio's first in-house legal role. You'll be our go-to person for all things legal: a commercial lawyer first and foremost and the owner of our full legal portfolio. You won't need to be an expert in every area, but you'll know when to answer yourself and when to orchestrate external support.

Reporting into our COO, you’ll become a trusted business partner to our leadership team and decision makers across Vio, pragmatically solving any problems and helping us think creatively about how we manage and mitigate our risk.

What you will do:

  • Write, review and negotiate our commercial contracts, starting with our affiliate and supply agreements

  • Be Vio's legal point of contact – orchestrating external counsel if required across all areas of the business, including but not limited to: Product and Consumer regulation (pricing transparency, DSA, GDPR, AI regulations), marketing and advertising rules, Employment (including hiring abroad and our Stock Appreciation Rights plan)

  • Corporate housekeeping and investment/transaction readiness

  • Baseline our current legal status and exposure and drive a plan to reduce legal debt

  • Get involved early alongside commercial and analytical leaders in contract and solution design, so what we build stands up to future legal scrut

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Germany.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
About us

Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can’t get anywhere else. We’re a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

Job Overview

As a Hardware Engineer at Salience Labs, you will play a crucial role in designing and testing the electronics that power our hybrid photonic-electronic systems. As an early member of the team, you will contribute directly to our mission of bringing photonic products to high-performance compute systems, particularly those used for AI.

The role offers a varied mix of system design, PCB design, system bring-up and qualification, with a significant share of hands-on lab work at our Oxford office.

What you’ll be doing

  • Carry out detailed hardware design, including specification, simulation, schematic capture (using Altium) and component selection. PCB layout experience is a strong advantage

  • Bring up and test new hardware in the lab, focusing on the electronics and how they interact with photonic elements

  • Diagnose and resolve issues during hardware bring-up and testing

  • Characterise new electronic systems and their integration with photonic components

  • Characterise the mechanical and thermal properties of our systems and their impact on photonic performance

  • Qualify electronic systems for production, working with external test houses as needed

  • Work closely with photonics, firmware and test colleagues to turn system requirements into hardware that works first time

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in high-speed digital or analogue design, including high-speed discrete analogue-to-digital conversion, high-performance FPGAs and high-speed digital interfaces (including Ethernet and DDR)

  • 3+ years of experience bringing up and testing new electronic systems

  • Strong diagnostic skills, including hands-on rework

  • Comfort working both independently and within small, multidiscipli

Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can’t get anywhere else. We’re a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Photonics Layout Lead to join our Photonics team and lead our Layout team, taking technical and people leadership of the physical design, verification and development of advanced integrated photonic devices.

You will work closely with engineers across photonic design, layout and testing, setting the direction for how device and circuit requirements are translated into robust, fabrication-ready layouts. The role combines hands-on physical layout, design verification, programming and ownership of our internal design workflows, along with leading, developing and managing the layout engineers on your team and raising the standard of layout work across the company.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of integrated photonics, semiconductor design and software. You should be comfortable leading the resolution of complex layout challenges, interpreting and challenging design requirements, and using programming to improve the speed, quality and repeatability of engineering work, while building a team that can do the same.

We are particularly interested in people who have led or significantly shaped integrated photonics or semiconductor IC layout work, and who have experience leading engineers, whether in industry, research or a strong academic environment.

title: AI Marketing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Marketing Specialist based in France.

As an AI Marketing Specialist, you will combine digital marketing expertise with artificial intelligence and automation to drive measurable business growth. You will develop and execute AI-powered marketing strategies across multiple channels, helping improve customer acquisition, lead generation, and campaign performance. Using generative AI tools and marketing automation platforms, you will create personalized content, optimize advertising campaigns, and streamline marketing operations. You will also leverage AI-driven insights to identify new market opportunities, understand customer behavior, and improve audience targeting. Working across paid advertising, SEO, content creation, and customer engagement, you will continuously experiment with emerging technologies. This is an opportunity to contribute to innovative marketing initiatives while delivering measurable results in a fully remote environment.


Accountabilities

You will lead the implementation and optimization of AI-driven marketing initiatives, using automation, data analysis, and emerging technologies to improve campaign effectiveness and business performance.

  • Develop and execute AI-driven digital marketing strategies across multiple channels to increase brand visibility, generate qualified leads, and improve customer acquisition.

  • Leverage generative AI tools to create, personalize, and optimize marketing materials, including advertising copy, landing pages, email campaigns, and social media content.

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns using AI-powered features and tools across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

  • Use AI solutions for audience research, customer segmentation, competitor analysis, and identifying new market opportunities.

  • Implement AI-powered SEO strategies, including keyword research, search intent analysis, content optimization, and editorial planning.

  • Build and optimize automated marketing workflows for lead generation, lead nurturing, and customer engagement.

  • Analyze campaign performance using AI-powered tools to identify trends, evaluate results, and generate actionable recommendations.

  • Implement AI-driven personalization strategies to enhance customer journeys, improve engagement, and increase conversion rates.

  • Experiment with AI-powered creative generation tools to develop and optimize advertising visuals and campaign assets.

title: Content Creator - YouTube
description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other

title: Ehrenamtliche Mitarbeit (m/w/d) – Bildungsprojekt in Namibia
description:
Über RCT Education

Die RCT Education gUG ist die gemeinnützige Bildungsinitiative der Erik RCT Filmproduktion GmbH aus Weinheim. Unser Ziel: Kindern, Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen aus den einkommensschwachen Stadtteilen von Rundu, der zweitgrößten Stadt Namibias, Zugang zu digitaler Bildung und Künstlicher Intelligenz zu ermöglichen.

Dafür bauen wir vor Ort eine eigene Computer- und KI-Schule auf – mit Klassenraum, Satelliten-Internet, Präsenzkursen und Online-Unterricht aus Deutschland. Die Teilnahme ist für die Schüler kostenlos oder zum reinen Selbstkostenpreis.

Hinweis: Es handelt sich um ein unbezahltes Ehrenamt für die gemeinnützige RCT Education gUG. Wir suchen gerne mehrere Personen.

Wobei du mithelfen kannst

Wir suchen helfende Hände für alles, was ein junges gemeinnütziges Projekt braucht – du suchst dir aus, wo du dich am meisten einbringen möchtest:

  • Spendenakquise & Spendenmanagement: Unterstützer, Unternehmen und Stiftungen gewinnen, Spenden betreuen, Spenderkommunikation
  • Verwaltung & Organisation: Dokumentation, Planung, Koordination von Aufgaben und Terminen
  • Social Media & Marketing: Kanäle aufbauen, Inhalte planen, die Geschichte des Projekts erzählen
  • Kommunikation mit Namibia: Austausch mit unserem Team und unseren Partnern vor Ort in Rundu

Was du mitbringst

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Englisch ist ein Plus für die Kommunikation mit Namibia)
  • Herz für Bildung und Lust, etwas Sinnvolles aufzubauen
  • Zuverlässigkeit und Eigeninitiative – du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung
  • Ein paar Stunden Zeit pro Woche, ganz flexibel
  • Bereitschaft, uns zu Beginn persönlich in Weinheim zu treffen

Was wir dir bieten

  • Namibia als Perspektive: Aktive Engagierte haben die Chance, bei Schulungsprogrammen vor Ort in Rundu dabei zu sein
  • Echte Verantwortung: Du bekommst deinen eigenen Bereich und gestaltest das Projekt von Anfang an mit
  • Persönliches Engagement- und Referenzzeugnis von Geschäftsführer Erik Faltermann
  • Portfolio-Material: Professionelle Fotos und Videoclips von deiner Arbeit für deinen Lebenslauf und LinkedIn
  • Einblick in professionelle Workflows aus der Filmproduktion bei Erik RCT
  • Arbeitsplatz im Erik RCT Headquarter in Weinheim
  • Flexibel: Zum Start treffen wir uns vor Ort, danach ist vieles auch remote möglich
  • Einladung zur Teamfeier von Erik RCT

Interesse?

title: Remote Head of UX (m/f/d)
description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As the Head of UX at RoomPriceGenie, you'll lead our small but mighty design and research team of two product designers and one user researcher.

This isn't an IC role where you'll be pushing pixels or running sessions yourself. It's a leadership role focused on building the function, championing the team, and setting them up for success.

You'll set the strategic direction for how design and research operates, advocate for the team at leadership level, and create the conditions for your people to do their best work. You'll also play a key role in raising design and research maturity across the wider product organisation — guiding better decisions through clearer systems, guidelines, and shared insight.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership Representation & Advocacy

  • Champion design and research as a strategic partner that shapes the roadmap.

  • Partner with Product Leadership to translate strategic business priorities into a clear, sequenced roadmap for Design & Research.

Strategic Direction & Vision

  • Set a clear vision for the design and research function — defining what success looks like, where it's heading, and how it contributes to the company's overall strategy.

Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
description:
Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team!

We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet.

We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates.

How we work:

  • Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies.
  • Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations.
  • AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs.
  • Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them.


Your responsibilities:

  • Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions.
  • Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal.
  • Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers.
  • Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments.
  • Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build.
  • Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn.


What you should bring:

  • At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar).
  • You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them.
  • Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state.
  • Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes.
  • You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests.
  • You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments.

title: Senior HVDC Cable Engineer – Manufacturing & Quality (Offshore Grid Connection, Germany)
description:
Location: Approx. 70% remote, 25% on site in Berlin, 5% travel to cable manufacturing and test sites in Europe
Start: 1 December 2026
Duration: Until 30 November 2028, extension possible
Workload: 440 days in total, approx. 220 days per year
Contract: Freelance

About the role

T.I.S. GmbH is looking for a Senior Cable Manufacturing & Quality Engineer for a 2 GW HVDC offshore grid connection (±525 kV) in the German North Sea. You will work on the owner’s side for a German transmission system operator and assess the series production of the HVDC cable systems for the LanWin3 2GW project. Your assessments cover the manufacturing, testing and documentation processes of the cable supplier and its subcontractors, and are the basis for the client’s technical decisions, along with a close coordination with the LanWin2 Project.

Your tasks

  • Type test phase

    • Review and document compliance with the project’s technical and quality requirements during the type test of the cable systems

    • Document deviations with their technical impact, risks and recommended follow-up actions

    • Analyse quality incidents and deviation reports: check the root cause analysis, assess the proposed corrective and preventive actions, and track their status and effectiveness

    • Classify non-conformities by cable system, technical discipline, quality impact and priority, and propose the review steps and disciplines to involve

    • Maintain the NC and action register

    • Prepare the technical input for quality meetings: open deviations, assessment status, risks and decisions required

  • Production and quality follow-up

    • Record and assess the production progress of the cable systems against the production and quality records provided

    • Document deviations from the planned manufacturing status and their impact on quality and schedule

    • Prepare periodic quality and production status reports and a final report, covering production status, new, open and closed NCs, corrective and preventive actions, outstanding evidence and test decisions, and recommendations for the client

What you bring

  • Technical degree or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering, high-voltage engineering, materials engineering or cable technology

  • Experience on at least one HVDC cable project, or an energy infrastructure project comparable in voltage level, manufacturing complexity and quality requirements

  • Proven knowledge of the manufacture and quality assurance of high-voltage or HVDC cable systems

title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
description:
Help shape the future of music teaching in London

Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair, Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London.

We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice.

You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week.

About Matchspace Music

Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place.

Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London.

What you’ll do

As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll:

  • Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks.

  • Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice.

  • Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team.

  • Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch.

  • Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community.

This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week, starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments.

What you’ll bring

We’d like to hear from musicians who:

  • Are actively connected to London’s music community.

  • Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works.

  • Enjoy meeting people and feel comfortable starting conversations.

  • Can share thoughtful, constructive feedback.

  • Want to help shape how we launch in London.

  • Can commit four hours per week for six months.

A student or recent graduate of a London conservatoire, we’re starting conversations at RAM, RCM, Guildhall and Trinity Laban, and welcome ambitious musicians from across the city, in any discipline: strings, piano, voice, jazz, composition and beyond.

What you’ll get

  • Paid participation: £25 per hour.

  • Flexible scheduling around your studies or other commitments.

  • Direct access to the founder and opportunities to contribute to product discussions.</

title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.


What You'll Do
  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success

This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk.

We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group

  • Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area.

  • Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole.

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. title: Compliance Director
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

We are seeking an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineer to build customer use cases on top of the Mistral stack for our defense, government and critical-infrastructure customers. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing cybersecurity-related agentic workflows focused on cyberdefense, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients — often in sovereign, on-premises or classified environments.

you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence.   • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

title: Head of Compliance
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

title: Customer Success Manager - Key
description:
About SugarAI

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI. We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next. More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference. Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done. If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Impact You Will Make in the Role

  • Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within client accounts. Act as a trusted advisor to guide clients in leveraging our CX platform for maximum impact, ensuring long-term satisfaction and value realization.

  • Account Ownership & Renewals: Own the entire post-sale lifecycle for assigned accounts, including ensuring timely contract renewals, driving retention strategies, and mitigating churn risks.

  • Growth Opportunities: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling across existing client portfolios. Leverage deep knowledge of clients’ business needs and our product offerings to provide tailored solutions.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Use client data and analytics to track account health, uncover opportunities, and tailor strategies that maximize customer success. Monitor key success metrics (e.g., adoption rates, usage patterns) to proactively address potential challenges and maximize renewal probability.

  • Collaboration & Networking: Work cross-functionally with sales, product, and support teams to address customer needs and deliver exceptional service. Identify new contacts and departments within existing accounts to expand product adoption and customer footprint.

  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the company. Gather feedback and communicate customer needs and insights across product, sales, and marketing teams to help guide the direction of product development and marketing strategies.

Remanence is pioneering the next era of enterprise AI by building intelligent systems that learn continuously from real-world execution. We transform complex enterprise workflows and business context into dynamic, interactive environments where AI agents can safely learn, adapt, and improve. By combining high-fidelity simulation environments with state-of-the-art training loops, we build specialized models that solve long-horizon, complex tasks with unmatched reliability. We’re assembling a core team of passionate AI builders in Europe to make this a reality.

You’ll develop post-training methods and own the performance of the systems that run them. The work spans learning algorithms, distributed training, and GPU performance, with responsibility for both model improvements and efficient experimentation.

What you’ll work on

  • Implement and improve supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and RL methods such as PPO, GRPO and SDPO.

  • Own the training loop from rollout generation and reward computation through policy updates, weight synchronization, and checkpointing.

  • Improve throughput, GPU utilization, and memory efficiency through batching, parallelism, communication overlap, and asynchronous execution.

  • Profile bottlenecks and investigate numerical instability, stale-policy effects, and training-inference discrepancies. Verify that optimizations preserve learning behavior.

  • Occasionally deploy models in client environments and hill-climb alongside their teams: analyze real failures, refine rewards and training data, and iterate on task success, latency, and inference cost.

Relevant technologies

  • Training: PyTorch, Miles, NVIDIA Molt, verl, FSDP, and Megatron-LM

  • Rollout generation: vLLM, SGLang, Ray and asynchronous execution frameworks.

  • Performance/Kernels: NCCL, CUDA, Triton and or CuTE

  • Profiling: PyTorch Profiler, NVIDIA Nsight Systems

About you

You bring strong programming skills, quantitative reasoning, and an interest in how learning algorithms interact with the systems underneath them. You can move from an experiment to a profiler trace and investigate what the evidence shows.

description:

title: Country Executive
description:
Country Executive

The Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring.

Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job.

Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week.

What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours.

This Is Not A Country Manager Role.

Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else.

No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need, the thing behind the thing they asked for, and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against.

  • Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions.

  • Owning the local rulebook. Compliance, regulation, filing, the specific ways finance is done badly in your country. You’re the person in the room who knows this, and you make sure it shows up in the product and in the pitch.

  • Having a public point of view. Ideally you arrive with a finance background and an opinion on what “doing finance right” looks like in your market. Bring it into the market, into the roadmap, and into how every prospect sees Light. Relationships, events, brand presence: built by you.

  • Closing, with London behind you.</

title: New Patient Nurse
description:
If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives.

This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey.

It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life.

What is the Role?

This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants.

This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient.

If you are looking for a quiet life, this is not the role for you. If you want to do meaningful clinical work from home and be part of a growing team that is changing how patients access medicine, it is.

This is a full-time role, working 40 hours per week. You will be required to work 1 Saturday per month, for which a day in lieu will be provided. This role is fully remote.

What Will You Be Doing?

  • Conducting video-based pre-assessment consultations with prospective patients

  • Taking detailed medical histories including current medications, relevant family history, and prior treatment

  • Assessing patient suitability for referral to Montu's clinical consultants

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential patient records

title: Mobility and Compliance Lead
description:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a Mobility and Compliance Lead to be the champion of mobility policy and compliance across Neko as we scale. You will make sure that everyone who joins Neko from another country, relocates between our locations, or works across borders for us can do so lawfully and with a seamless experience, and that the business is never exposed to right-to-work, immigration or cross-border employment risk.

This role sits at the point where detail meets people. You will get into the detail of immigration rules, relocation packages and cross-border obligations, and you will be the visible, reassuring face of mobility for candidates, new joiners, employees and leaders. When the answer is no, or not by that date, you will say so clearly, explain why, and show what the compliant alternatives are.

You will lead through ownership, expertise and influence, working closely with People Enablement, Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal and our external advisers.

title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

What you will do

  • Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

Why now?
AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest. Founders and leaders from Qonto, Photoroom, Bitpanda, UBS and Wise also invested.

We’re 70 builders with real ownership from day 1, tier-1 salary and equity, and offices in central Paris with hybrid remote. Our culture is direct and built on radical candor. AI is a real bar here: everyone has rebuilt how they work around it. Read more about our values here.

More than 1M people track and grow their wealth with Finary. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination.

Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) · 11 Gameshow-Filialen · Remote mit Reisen
description:
Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Start sofort · Firmenwagen · Berichtet an den Gründer

Du führst 80+ Werkstudenten in 11 Filialen in ganz Deutschland. Filialleiter gibt es nicht. Du arbeitest von zu Hause, bist jede Woche in einer Filiale und greifst, wenn nötig, auch am Wochenende ein.

Gamer - Die Gameshow

Bei uns wird ein Ausflug mit Freunden oder Kollegen zur Gameshow. Aus über 20.000 Google Bewertungen haben wir 4,9 Sterne. 2027 wachsen wir weiter stark mit vielen neuen Filialen.

Spiele, Technik und Software sind unsere Stärke. Der Betrieb unserer Filialen ist es bisher nicht. Trotz guter Bewertungen zeigt das Feedback unserer Gäste, dass es vor Ort zu oft hakt, z. B. bei der Sauberkeit und beim Wohlfühlen. Uns fehlt die Erfahrung, Strukturen und Abläufe so aufzubauen, dass sie auch funktionieren, wenn niemand von uns da ist. Diese Erfahrung bringst du mit.

Deine Aufgabe

  • Der Betrieb unserer 11 eigenen Filialen liegt bei dir: Teams, Abläufe und alles, was nötig ist, um Gäste vor Ort glücklich zu machen.
  • Du führst die mehr als 80 Werkstudenten: von der Auswahl über das Training bis zum Abschied.
  • Du baust die Strukturen auf, die heute fehlen. Welche das sind, findest du selbst heraus.
  • Du bringst neue Filialen operativ an den Start.
  • Du startest nicht allein: In deinem Team ist ein starker Operations Manager, der unsere Filialen und Werkstudenten sehr gut kennt.
  • Die Richtung stimmst du direkt mit unserem Gründer ab.

Daran merken wir, dass es klappt

  • Gäste loben die Filiale, statt sie zu bemängeln. Auch an einem vollen Samstag.
  • Die Teams arbeiten auch dann nach Standard, wenn niemand zuschaut.
  • Gute Werkstudenten bleiben und werben andere an.
  • Der NPS in jeder Filiale steigt deutlich, die Personalkosten dagegen steigen nicht.

Der schwierigste Teil

  • 11 Filialen, ein Besuch pro Woche: Jede Filiale siehst du nur einmal im Quartal.
  • Dazwischen führst du über Systeme, Telefon und das Feedback der Gäste, das du in Echtzeit siehst.
  • Standards zu entwickeln ist der leichte Teil. Der schwierige ist, dass sie auch ohne dich gelten.

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Remote-First ohne Headquarter.
  • Wir schreiben lieber, als zu telefonieren. Entscheidungen fallen in Minuten per Chat, nicht in einem Meeting.
  • Kein Ego. Kein Bullshit. Wir kommunizieren immer direkt und ehrlich.
  • Leistung zählt mehr als jeder Titel. Wir arbeiten wie ein erfolgreiches Sport-Team. Nur wer Vollgas für unseren Erfolg gibt, ist Teil des Teams.
  • Fehler sind komplett okay, jeder aber bitte nur einmal.
  • Technik vor Personal: Was eine Software erledigen kann, soll kein Mensch machen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du führst über die Auswahl der richtigen Leute, gutes Training, klare Erwartungen und konsequente Kontrolle, nicht über Angst.
  • Du packst mit an. Siehst

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:
