  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

  • Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

  • Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Nice, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Denn bei uns verfolgen wir GENAU ein Ziel:

Wir helfen Handwerksbetrieben in ganz Deutschland dabei, planbar neue Aufträge zu gewinnen und zuverlässige Mitarbeiter aus der Region einzustellen. Falls du Bock auf Skalierung hast und Systeme lieber selbst baust, statt nur zuzuschauen, dann hast du bei uns deine neue Peergroup gefunden. Solange du Ergebnisse lieferst, hast du volle Freiheit und Vertrauen, deinen Alltag so zu gestalten, wie es dir passt.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen, der aus den Antworten auf deine Kampagnen Termine macht.

We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About this role

You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction.

What you will do:

  • Own the fabric architecture for every site: GPU backend fabric (InfiniBand and/or RoCEv2), and GPU frontend Fabric

  • Choose topologies and make the key calls: rail-optimized vs. other designs, InfiniBand vs. Ethernet, oversubscription ratios, and how the fabric scales from one pod to many

  • Turn the architecture into a repeatable network blueprint: cabling plans, port maps, fabric addressing and routing design, and a fabric bill of materials (switches, NICs, optics, cables)

  • Get hands-on with bring-up at each site: be on the floor for the first racks, validate cabling and firmware, configure the fabric manager and switches, and run performance acceptance (NCCL tests, burn-in) before capacity goes live

  • Tune for real workload performance: congestion control, PFC/ECN, adaptive routing, and NCCL settings for both inference and training traffic

  • Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow

  • Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec

description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. title: Lead Data Scientist
Founding Implementation Manager (Italian Speaking)
description:
About Sona

Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

We're hiring a Founding Implementation Manager to lead how Sona implements in Italy. You'll be the first person doing this job in the market, and you'll own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live.

In the UK, our implementations follow an established playbook. In Italy there isn't one yet, so working out how we do this well is part of the job. Expect a lot of unknowns and plans that change. You'll build a clear picture of the lay of the land, take the route that gets us there fastest and bring in the right people from Product, Commercial, our customers and local specialists when they're needed.

Day to day, that means keeping a lot of moving parts pointed in the same direction, with stakeholders across our customers, Product and the wider Sona team, and relationships that are rarely simple. You'll own the relationships with our first Italian customers, and build a network of local labour specialists, consultancy-based, whilst you deliver those first implementations.

This role isn't for everyone. If you want a defined process and clear direction on what to do next, you'll find it frustrating. If you love ambiguity and changes of plan, take ownership of every implementation and make the next one better than the last, you'll shape how Sona implements in Italy from the start.

Responsibilities

  • Work out how Sona implements in Italy, and capture what you learn so each implementation starts from a better place than the last.

  • Own every Italian implementation
